data.name: The gateway keeps the protocol shape and rewrites only gateway-owned values and configured policy fields.

data.name: The navigation bar automatically adjusts based on user roles and permissions.
data.value: 导航栏会根据用户角色和权限自动调整显示内容。

data.name: The original request and successful response JSON are cloned; unknown fields are preserved; model identity is rewritten.
data.value: 原始请求和成功响应的 JSON 会被克隆；未知字段将予以保留；模型身份将被重写。

data.name: The original request and successful response JSON are cloned; unknown OpenAI embedding fields are preserved; only model identity is rewritten.
data.value: 原始请求和成功响应的 JSON 会被克隆；未知的 OpenAI 嵌入字段将予以保留；仅模型标识会被重写。

data.name: The provider-level keep_alive replaces the client value on this route.
data.value: 提供者级别的 keep_alive 将替换此路由上的客户端值。

data.name: The request adapter deep-clones the original Responses JSON. OpenAiResponsesWireResponseWriter preserves unknown output Items and SSE event names/data/comments/id/retry without passing the payload through canonical IL.
data.value: 请求适配器会对原始 Responses JSON 进行深拷贝。OpenAiResponsesWireResponseWriter 会保留未知的输出 Items 以及 SSE 事件名称/数据/注释/id/retry，而无需将负载通过标准 IL 传递。

data.name: The template is built for easy deployment. It includes full Docker support, so you can containerize your app and run it anywhere. You can also deploy it directly to IIS, Azure App Service, or any server that supports ASP.NET Core.
data.value: 该模板专为简化部署而设计，内置完整的Docker支持，您可以将应用容器化后随处运行。也可直接部署到IIS、Azure应用服务或任何支持ASP.NET Core的服务器。

data.name: There is no Chat Completions or Responses translation. A non-Ollama backend returns 501.
data.value: 不提供 Chat Completions 或 Responses 的协议转换。非 Ollama 后端将返回 501。

data.name: These endpoints do not proxy physical provider metadata. Ollama size/digest/runtime details are placeholders or omitted.
data.value: 这些端点不会代理物理提供商的元数据。Ollama 的大小/摘要/运行时详细信息为占位符或省略。

data.name: Thinking signatures are discarded. Unknown content blocks remain a hard rejection. Anthropic-only top-level controls prefer a future Anthropic backend but are omitted when Chat is the only eligible route.
data.value: 思维签名将被丢弃。未知内容块将导致硬性拒绝。仅限 Anthropic 的顶层控件优先使用未来的 Anthropic 后端，但在 Chat 是唯一可用路由时会被省略。

data.name: This avoids recursive upstream discovery when a Provider points back to the gateway and keeps the public catalog scoped to virtual models.
data.value: 这避免了当 Provider 指向网关时发生递归的上游发现，并确保公共目录仅限于虚拟模型。

data.name: This is a template project, where we start the voyager...
data.value: 这是一个模板项目，我们将从这里开启探索之旅...

data.name: Trusted by production-grade applications including AnduinOS, StatHub, and Warp. We don't just share this code; we run our entire business on it.
data.value: 深受生产级应用信赖，包括 AnduinOS、StatHub 和 Warp。我们不仅分享代码，我们的核心业务也完全构建于此。

data.name: Two client dialects × two Provider types
data.value: 两种客户端方言 × 两种 Provider 类型

data.name: Unknown request fields, messages, tools, options, format, and unknown JSON response fields are retained. Malformed upstream NDJSON records are forwarded raw.
data.value: 未知请求字段、messages、tools、options、format 以及未知 JSON 响应字段将予以保留。格式错误的上游 NDJSON 记录将以原始形式转发。

data.name: Unknown request fields, message/content extensions, response_format, reasoning_effort, vendor fields, unknown response fields, null values, and unrecognized SSE lines remain in the Chat dialect.
data.value: 未知的请求字段、消息/内容扩展、response_format、reasoning_effort、供应商字段、未知的响应字段、null 值以及无法识别的 SSE 行将保留在 Chat 方言中。

data.name: Unknown top-level and nested request fields, native tools, metadata, future Items, annotations, citations, unknown response fields, future SSE event types, and JSON/non-JSON event data are retained.
data.value: 未知的顶级和嵌套请求字段、原生工具、元数据、未来的 Items、注释、引用、未知的响应字段、未来的 SSE 事件类型以及 JSON/非 JSON 事件数据将被保留。

data.name: Use it as a foundation for your SaaS, a backend for your mobile app, a corporate website, or a personal blog. The possibilities are endless.
data.value: 无论是作为SaaS应用的基础、移动应用的后端、企业官网还是个人博客，它都能胜任。无限可能，任您探索。

data.name: Verified compatibility with Claude Code agent
data.value: 已与 Claude Code 代理验证兼容性

data.name: Verified compatibility with Opencode ecosystem
data.value: 经验证，完全兼容 Opencode 生态

data.name: Virtual-model names and gateway-owned metadata are rendered directly in the requested client shape.
data.value: 虚拟模型名称和网关自有元数据将直接以请求的客户端格式呈现。

data.name: VM NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK, and RepeatPenalty are injected into Ollama options.
data.value: VM NumCtx、Temperature、TopP、TopK 和 RepeatPenalty 将注入到 Ollama options 中。

data.name: VM NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK, and RepeatPenalty hard-override Ollama options.
data.value: VM NumCtx、Temperature、TopP、TopK 和 RepeatPenalty 将强制覆盖 Ollama options。

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict, and Thinking override Chat target controls; Chat-only VM thinking is injected through chat_template_kwargs.
data.value: VM Temperature、TopP、NumPredict 和 Thinking 会覆盖 Chat 目标控件；仅适用于 Chat 的 VM thinking 会通过 chat_template_kwargs 注入。

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict, and Thinking override Chat target fields. Ollama-only DB sampling/context controls do not apply to Chat.
data.value: VM Temperature、TopP、NumPredict 和 Thinking 将覆盖 Chat 目标字段。仅限 Ollama 的数据库采样/上下文控制不适用于 Chat。

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, NumPredict, and Thinking override their target fields. Existing nested chat_template_kwargs members are preserved around enable_thinking.
data.value: VM Temperature、TopP、NumPredict 和 Thinking 将覆盖其目标字段。现有的嵌套 chat_template_kwargs 成员将在 enable_thinking 周围保留。

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override temperature, top_p, and max_output_tokens. Other nested Responses fields remain untouched.
data.value: VM Temperature、TopP 和 NumPredict 将覆盖 temperature、top_p 和 max_output_tokens。其他嵌套的 Responses 字段保持不变。

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override temperature, top_p, and max_output_tokens. Other VM sampling fields are not applicable.
data.value: VM Temperature、TopP 和 NumPredict 会覆盖 temperature、top_p 和 max_output_tokens。其他 VM 采样字段不适用。

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override Responses fields. VM Thinking, TopK, NumCtx, and RepeatPenalty have no Responses target field.
data.value: VM Temperature、TopP 和 NumPredict 将覆盖 Responses 字段。VM Thinking、TopK、NumCtx 和 RepeatPenalty 没有对应的 Responses 目标字段。

data.name: VM Temperature, TopP, and NumPredict override Responses target fields. VM Thinking, TopK, NumCtx, and RepeatPenalty are not Responses controls.
data.value: VM Temperature、TopP 和 NumPredict 会覆盖 Responses 目标字段。VM Thinking、TopK、NumCtx 和 RepeatPenalty 不是 Responses 控制项。

data.name: VM Thinking, NumCtx, Temperature, TopP, TopK, NumPredict, and RepeatPenalty override the request; missing keep_alive uses the Provider value.
data.value: VM Thinking、NumCtx、Temperature、TopP、TopK、NumPredict 和 RepeatPenalty 会覆盖请求；若缺失 keep_alive，则使用 Provider 的值。

data.name: What do I need to get started?
data.value: 我需要准备什么才能开始？

data.name: When a virtual model has parameters configured in the database, those values always override what the client sends.
data.value: 当虚拟模型在数据库中配置了参数时，这些值将始终覆盖客户端发送的值。

data.name: Why use the Aiursoft Template?
data.value: 为何选择 Aiursoft 模板？

data.name: Yes, Aiursoft Template is completely free and open-source under the MIT License. You can use it for personal and commercial projects without any cost.
data.value: 是的，Aiursoft Template 在 MIT 许可证下完全免费且开源。您可以在个人和商业项目中免费使用它，无需任何费用。

data.name: You can get community support via GitHub Discussions. Please visit our
data.value: 您可以通过 GitHub Discussions 获取社区支持。请访问我们的

data.name: You'll need the .NET 10 SDK, npm and your favorite IDE, like Visual Studio or JetBrains Rider. You can find the full setup guide in our documentation.
data.value: 您需要安装 .NET 10 SDK、npm 以及您喜欢的 IDE（如 Visual Studio 或 JetBrains Rider）。完整的设置指南可在我们的文档中找到。

data.name: Your enterprise users don't need to register repeatedly.
data.value: 您的企业用户无需重复注册。
